name: legion
description: Solo/indie marketplace — a battle orchestration plugin for personal .NET projects on GitHub.

plugins.name: legion
plugins.description: Battle orchestration for solo .NET projects on GitHub. Drives a Think→Plan→Build→Lint→Review→Test→Deliver→Reflect pipeline with role-based gate agents, a builder producer, per-repo battle state, a multi-repo fleet view and write-scope guardrails. Orchestrates — delegates the actual .NET work to dotnet-claude-kit.
